## Data

This directory describes the datasets used in the analysis of temporal changes in BMI and height-for-age distributions among Russian children.

## Data sources

The analysis uses anthropometric data collected in two periods:

First is "2012 dataset" — data used to develop the historical Russian GAMLSS reference model. Bioimpedance study of body composition in the Russian population / S.G. Rudnev, N.P. Soboleva, S.A. Sterlikov, D.V. Nikolaev, O.A. Starunova, S.P. Chernykh, T.A. Eryukova, V.A. Kolesnikov, O.A. Melnichenko, E.G. Ponomareva. M.: RIO TSNIIOIZ, 2014. – 493 p. – ISBN 5‐94116‐018‐6
Second is "2025 dataset" — contemporary anthropometric data used to describe BMI and height-for-age distributions and to assess differences from the 2012 reference model.

The datasets includes children aged  5–12.5 years from multiple Russian regions.

##Variables

The main variables required for the analyses include:

age_in_months;
sex;
body_ _weight;
body_height;
age_in_years;
region.

Derived variables, including BMI, are generated within the analysis scripts where applicable.

##Data availability

Individual-level participant data are not included in this repository because they are subject to data protection and ethical restrictions.

#Data processing

The analysis scripts are provided to document the complete data-processing and statistical-modelling workflow. Researchers with appropriate access to the underlying data can reproduce the analyses using the scripts provided in the repository.

##The data-processing workflow includes:

removal of duplicate records;
exclusion of biologically implausible values;
multivariate quality control;
exploratory data analysis;
preparation of datasets for GAMLSS modelling.

The corresponding procedures are documented in the numbered R scripts in the main repository.
